subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions
cluster: Forces at a distance and materials

items.prompt:
Gravity is a force that is always
A) attractive
B) repulsive
C) zero
D) random

Two like charges (both positive) will
A) attract
B) repel
C) do nothing
D) disappear

Opposite charges will
A) attract
B) repel
C) vanish
D) freeze

As two objects move farther apart, the gravity between them
A) gets weaker
B) gets stronger
C) stays the same
D) reverses

As two charges move farther apart, the electric force between them
A) gets weaker
B) gets stronger
C) stays the same
D) becomes gravity

steps: The electric force weakens with distance.

items.prompt:
Larger masses create a ____ gravitational force.
A) stronger
B) weaker
C) zero
D) repulsive

A key difference between gravity and the electric force is that
A) gravity only attracts, while the electric force can attract or repel
B) gravity only repels
C) the electric force only attracts
D) they are identical
items.answer: A) gravity only attracts, while the electric force can attract or repel

steps: Gravity attracts; electric can attract or repel.

items.prompt:
Both gravity and the electric force
A) get weaker as distance increases
B) get stronger with distance
C) ignore distance
D) only act when touching
items.answer: A) get weaker as distance increases
